answer: Rio Tinto adjusts the 2018 baseline to exclude apparent reductions caused by divestments and to incorporate emissions associated with acquisitions. The adjusted-equity method applies current economic interests and current corporate/asset ownership retrospectively to the base year; expansions and closures do not trigger baseline changes. The former Arcadium Lithium portfolio was included in the 2025 Scope 1 and 2 emissions calculations and in the adjusted baseline.

normalized_value.acquisition_rule: incorporate acquisition emissions and restate baseline to current ownership
